engine_name: Scene Branching, Decision & Narrative Consequence Engine
purpose: Evaluate explicit narrative decision points, select a governed branch, propagate its immediate and downstream consequences, and promote only the selected path into canonical scene reality.
core_principle: Character agency selects a narrative path; the selected path becomes canon only after its conditions, causal consequences and continuity are validated.
decision_model: decision_context + character_state + knowledge_state + relationship_pressure + available_branches → selected_branch → consequence_chain → validated_canonical_path

decision_schema.rule: Selection must be explainable from available character state and scene conditions; the engine must not grant unavailable information.

consequence_model.propagation_rule: A selected branch may trigger downstream consequences only through explicit causal edges or validated transition contracts.
consequence_model.latent_rule: Unselected valid branches remain latent and cannot mutate canonical reality.
consequence_model.irreversibility: A consequence marked irreversible cannot be silently removed by later branch selection.

agency_rules: A character cannot select a branch using information unavailable under CSD-007.
Emotion can influence a decision but cannot substitute for a missing factual prerequisite.
A decision must have an actor with a valid active character state.
The engine does not rank branches as morally or narratively superior.
If multiple branches remain valid and no explicit selection exists, status is AWAITING_DECISION rather than arbitrary selection.
External forces may constrain or eliminate branches only through explicit event conditions.
A branch selection cannot mutate immutable identity.
Maximum five active characters remains enforced.
consequence_rules: Every promoted consequence maps to an originating selected branch.
Knowledge consequences route through CSD-007 and require acquisition provenance.
Physical/world consequences route through CSD-012 and CSD-011.
Unselected branches remain queryable as latent alternatives.
Branch convergence cannot erase branch-specific history.
A later scene may reference a latent alternative only if an explicit variant/revision path is opened.

output_contract.frame_handoff: CSD-002 must reflect selected canonical path

demo_test.decision_point: Choose escalation or restraint after Rama maintains a controlled challenge.

knowledge_used: Ravana knows his own intention and the visible response from Rama

consequence_chain.effect: scene question shifts toward mastery versus force
